title: Stop and remove product-negative Progress strategies from local and product systems
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: Давай предварительно удалим все Progress стратегии с отрицательным Gross Pnl. Включая их логику и историю но локальном и продуктовом серверах

1 - Да, удаляем всё. Но, наверное, надо сначала остановить эти стратегии, чтобы новых не создавали ордеров.

2. Удаляем без резервной копии
Сервис останавливать не будем. Сейчас просто остановим стратегии, подождём сутки, а потом всё удалим.
Я имею в виду - остановим те стратегии, которые будем удалять, а не все стратегии вообще

scope.goal: Disable only the fixed product-negative Progress allowlist on both databases while the service and every non-target strategy continue running, wait for a complete 24-hour target creation-free period, then use only a normal brief deployment restart to activate the new build and irreversibly remove those exact variants, their dispatch/catalog membership, and all exactly attributable structured local and product history without a backup.
inScope: Progress uses the application's exact case-insensitive visible-name predicate: strategy name contains `Progress`.

Gross uses lifetime Paper Gross realized and lifetime Paper Gross MtM. On the product snapshot both predicates selected the same exact 220 UUIDs; Gross Live selected zero. The target is frozen to those 220 UUID/code pairs and is not recalculated during disable or deletion.

Product identity at selection: 192.168.0.101:5432/polycopytrader, PostgreSQL 18.3, service build d7e18a654b4c093412daf74a2ccc2e5efda31255, raw verification cutoff 2026-08-13T20:14:11Z. Exactly 220 targets were present, with zero snapshot/raw Gross mismatches across 795095 settled Paper rows.

Local identity at preview: 127.0.0.1:5432/polycopytrader, PostgreSQL 17.5, snapshot 2026-08-13T20:44:49.726133Z. Exactly 132 of the fixed 220 targets were present and 88 were absent; absent rows remain absent and no local-only negative strategy is substituted.

The family expansion must produce exactly 220 distinct UUID/code pairs before either database is changed.

Stage 1 changes only exact targets that exist: product expected 220 and local expected 132. Set enabled=false, live_stakes=false, paused=true with no expiry, clear auto-pause anchors and live_enabled_at_utc, and record each database commit timestamp. No other strategy row changes.

The service remains running and all non-target strategies remain available throughout Stage 1 and the 24-hour observation period. The quiet-period clock begins at the later successful database commit; if already in-flight work creates a new target Paper/Live order or strategy run afterward, the clock restarts at the latest such creation. Updates or settlement of target rows that already existed at Stage 1 do not restart the clock because those rows are intentionally deleted in Stage 2.

Stage 2 begins only after a complete 24-hour target creation-free period and a fresh read-only preview confirms the fixed identities, target states, no target Live orders, and no target Paper/Live order or strategy run created during that period. Any mismatch or newly created target order/run stops deletion and restarts or blocks the observation period.

Delete the fixed targets even though the product preview contained 506 Observed/Entered runs and 257 open Paper positions; all target operational state and structured history are intentionally removed regardless of settlement state.

Remove exact target variants from runtime catalog and every SQL seed path so an existing or future startup cannot recreate or dispatch them. Retain shared Progress algorithms required by non-target variants.

Use one fail-closed atomic transaction per database with a fixed allowlist, exact ownership collection, guards, ordered deletion, collected-versus-deleted checks, and zero-residual postconditions. The service itself is not deliberately stopped for deletion.

A normal brief service restart is allowed only to deploy and activate the new binary after the 24-hour gate. During that restart the schema initializer runs the approved fail-closed cleanup before workers start, and the service must then start automatically; the service is not left stopped as a quiescence method or maintenance state.

Delete exactly attributable structured rows from strategies; Paper orders, fills, runs, positions and settlements; Live/dry-run/shadow rows; signals and rejections when not shared; onchain Paper results; Progress state; Child assignments; retention guards, rollups, v1/v2 target tombstones; fee events; copied-leader/performance rows; Dashboard snapshots, projection state/facts/events/queues/cursors; and exact legacy maintenance rows when present.

After code deployment and deletion, verify exact target UUID/code/wallet absence, zero structured residuals, no reseed after at least two worker cycles, and unchanged non-target strategy identities/counts on both databases.
outOfScope: Deliberately stopping or leaving the Windows service stopped as a quiescence or maintenance method, stopping all strategies, pausing or modifying any non-target strategy, or cancelling unrelated Paper/Live activity. This does not exclude the user-approved normal brief restart required to activate the new deployment.
Selecting separate local negatives, adding local-only candidates, recalculating the allowlist after Stage 1, or deleting a strategy merely because its description/category contains Progress.
Deleting shared Progress processor methods still used by retained variants, or changing the behavior of retained strategies.
Deleting shared/global v2 dimension rows or shared market/API/onchain data that is not owned by an exact target.
Creating any backup, dump, archive, restore point, or recovery copy.
VACUUM FULL, pg_repack, database-file shrink, index rationalization, compact-v2 activation, or any separate storage-reclaim operation.
Deploying an old binary that still seeds the removed variants after Stage 2.

scope.firstVerification: In read-only UTC snapshots, independently identify the product and local database endpoints, expand and validate the exact 220-pair allowlist, verify product/local target membership and runtime states, reconcile the product Gross snapshot against base history, and count active Paper/Live state before any mutation.

requirements.text: Use one immutable 220-pair product-derived Progress allowlist on both local and product systems.
requirements.sourceQuote: все Progress стратегии с отрицательным Gross Pnl
acceptanceCriteria: The compact family specification expands to exactly 220 unique UUID/code pairs and matches the product snapshot set for both Gross realized < 0 and Gross MtM < 0.
Product membership is exactly 220 and local membership is exactly the already observed 132; 88 exact targets may be absent locally, but no local-only row is added.
Every mutation joins both UUID and code and fails closed on any ID/code collision, unexpected target count, near-alias, or changed fixed allowlist.
The selection is not recomputed from a later PnL value during Stage 1 or Stage 2.

verification.command: Run the focused retired-Progress catalog tests against the exact expanded allowlist.
verification.expected: Exactly 220 unique UUID/code pairs are absent from the runtime catalog and seed definitions, while every non-target catalog variant remains.

verification.command: Run bounded UTC REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY target-membership checks on 192.168.0.101:5432/polycopytrader and 127.0.0.1:5432/polycopytrader before each mutation stage.
verification.expected: The exact fixed membership and UUID/code identities match the approved allowlist; unexpected rows or collisions abort mutation.

requirements.text: Stop only the target strategies, keep the service and all other strategies running, and wait at least 24 hours before deletion.
requirements.sourceQuote: Сейчас просто остановим стратегии, подождём сутки, а потом всё удалим.
acceptanceCriteria: One transaction per database sets enabled=false, live_stakes=false, paused=true, paused_until_utc=NULL, auto_live_paused=false, auto_live_paused_at_utc=NULL, auto_live_pause_window_start_utc=NULL, and live_enabled_at_utc=NULL only for exact existing targets.
The Stage 1 transaction returns and records exact updated UUID/code pairs and a database commit timestamp; expected updated counts are 220 product and 132 local.
All non-target strategy control fields are byte-for-byte unchanged, and the PolyCopyTrader service remains running.

Stage 2 cannot run until at least 24 hours have elapsed from the later successful Stage 1 commit or, if already in-flight work creates a new target Paper/Live order or strategy run after disable, from the latest such creation.

Immediately before Stage 2, two bounded read-only observations compare exact target Paper/Live order and strategy-run identities and their created_at_utc values and confirm no target row was created during the complete 24-hour period; updates or settlement of pre-existing rows are allowed, while any new identity or state reversal aborts deletion and restarts or blocks the period.

verification.command: Execute Stage 1 as exact allowlisted database transactions and immediately re-read target and non-target control states in UTC read-only transactions.
verification.expected: Only 220 product and 132 local target rows are disabled/live-off/paused; services stay healthy and non-target controls do not change.

verification.command: At or after T+24h, compare exact target Paper/Live order and strategy-run identity ledgers and query their created_at_utc values against the later Stage 1 commit or latest post-disable target creation.
verification.expected: No target strategy is re-enabled and no new target Paper/Live order or strategy-run identity is created during the full 24-hour period; updates or settlement of rows that existed before Stage 1 do not fail the gate.

requirements.text: Delete every exactly attributable structured record for the targets, including unfinished runs and open Paper positions.
acceptanceCriteria: Stage 2 intentionally includes the 506 product Observed/Entered runs and 257 product open Paper positions seen at preview, plus every other target row found at the fresh pre-delete snapshot.

A single atomic fail-closed transaction per database collects exact target-owned IDs, rejects active Live orders and shared ownership conflicts, deletes in FK-safe order, and verifies collected versus deleted counts.
Every current structured target dependency named in scope is either deleted or proven absent; v2 target tombstones are deleted without deleting shared v2 dimension rows.
Postconditions find zero target UUID, code, strategy wallet, order, run, position, settlement, tombstone, rollup, assignment, snapshot, projection, queue, and exactly attributable audit rows.
Non-target strategy identities/counts and sampled non-target history remain unchanged.

verification.command: Run focused PostgreSQL cleanup tests with target Paper/Live/shadow/state/projection/v1-v2 fixtures and fail-closed conflict cases.
verification.expected: All target structured rows are atomically removed, shared/non-target rows survive, and any guard failure rolls back the whole database transaction.

verification.command: After Stage 2, run exact zero-residual and non-target-count queries on local and product databases immediately and after at least two worker cycles.
verification.expected: Zero target structured residuals or reseeded strategy rows; non-target counts and service health remain valid.

requirements.text: Remove the selected strategies' runnable logic without breaking shared Progress behavior used by retained strategies.
acceptanceCriteria: The exact 220 variants are excluded from StrategyIds runtime registry, static SQL seeds, dynamic LowerEnter generation, and every startup reseed path.
No retained strategy references a removed target through LowerEnterSourceStrategyId, BaseSignalStrategyId, ConfirmationSignalStrategyId, or a persisted Child assignment.

Shared behavior enum values and processor implementations remain only where at least one retained variant still consumes them; exact targets cannot dispatch because their catalog identities no longer exist.
Focused catalog and processor tests prove retained positive Progress siblings still resolve and execute their unchanged shared behavior.

verification.command: Run focused Progress catalog, seed, clone-reference, Child-assignment, and processor regression tests.
verification.expected: All 220 targets are absent and cannot dispatch or reseed; every retained Progress variant and shared behavior remains valid.

verification.command: dotnet build PolyCopyTrader.sln with outputs under the active marked D:\CodexTemp run.
verification.expected: The solution builds with zero errors.

requirements.text: Perform the deletion without a backup or a deliberate service-wide stop, while allowing the normal brief restart required to deploy and activate the new build.
acceptanceCriteria: No database dump, backup, archive, restore point, or copied target history is created.
The user is informed that each committed database deletion is irreversible and that local/product commits cannot be atomic with each other.

No deliberate service stop or global strategy pause is used as a quiescence method. After the 24-hour gate, one normal brief restart may activate the new binary; its initializer completes the fail-closed cleanup before workers start and the service then starts automatically.
If a database transaction fails, that database rolls back fully. If one database commits and the other fails, report the split state and do not claim cross-database rollback or completion.

verification.command: Inspect executed commands, deployment timestamps, service state, transaction results, and artifact inventory for backup or service-stop operations.
verification.expected: No backup artifact and no deliberate stopped interval exist; only the normal deployment restart occurs, the service returns healthy automatically, and each database transaction has an explicit commit or rollback result.

verification.command: Run git diff --check and .\scripts\requirements\Validate-RequirementContract.ps1 -Mode WorkingTree, then staged validation before commit.
verification.expected: No whitespace errors and requirement validation passes with completed evidence and independent review.

assumptions.text: The product-derived fixed 220 UUID/code set is authoritative for source removal and for both databases; local-only negative Progress strategies are not additional targets.
assumptions.impact: Product will remove 220 strategies and local will remove the 132 members currently present. Four local Gross-realized-only and fifteen local Gross-MtM-only UUIDs outside the product set remain because the source catalog is global and the local database is stale.

deviations.text: Shared Progress processor methods are retained when a non-target strategy still uses them; target-specific logic removal means removing exact catalog, seed, clone, reference, and dispatch identities.
deviations.impact: The selected 220 strategies cannot run or be recreated, but generic Progress implementation code remains for retained profitable variants instead of being globally deleted.

deviations.text: Shared or unstructured global text logs and API/risk/live event rows without a verified exact target key are not deleted.
deviations.impact: All exactly attributable structured target history is deleted, but an unattributable text message may remain when deleting it would also remove evidence belonging to retained strategies.
